sourceRoles.completeExecutionAnnex: Supplies the full-state parent/grand totals and the exact central-budget detail rows used for carve-outs.
sourceRoles.treasuryCentralE11: Corroborates the narrower central-budget scope and parent aggregates only; supplies no review-row amount.

scope.publicFacts: Complete 2004 state-budget actual from annex page 232.
scope.supportingCarveOuts: Exact sport, debt, and intergovernmental-transfer carve-outs come from central-budget detail rows inside the complete execution annex.
scope.centralCorroboration: The separate Treasury E11 PDF is used only for central-scope and parent-aggregate corroboration.
scope.excluded: The central-budget grand total is narrower than the complete state budget and is never emitted.

notes: Pre-COFOG 14-group functional classification mapped to public spending categories.
Complete state-budget group totals are never prorated; only exact source-backed carve-outs are subtracted.
-100 GEL source-table rounding adjustment is retained in spending.other_unclassified.
